title: PoseCascade declarative animation v1
description: JSON document parsed by posecascade.scripting.declarative.parse_animation. Drives a character demo as data — phase timeline, body trajectory, gait, ground geometry, physics chain tunings, morph weights — without writing Python.

schema_version.description: Schema generation. Older / newer versions are rejected with DeclarativeAnimationError.

loop_sec.description: Total animation length. Defaults to the sum of phase durations.

bpm.description: Beats per minute. When > 0, phases may use 'duration_beats' instead of 'duration_sec', and the expression DSL gains 'beat' (= elapsed * bpm / 60) and 'phase_beat' variables. Defaults to 0 (tempo-less).

pose_library.description: Custom pose presets keyed by name. Each entry is {bone_name: {x_rad?, y_rad?, z_rad?: number}}. Overlays the built-in library (v_arms_up, arms_to_chest, hip_pop_L, hip_pop_R, point_L, point_R, hands_clasp); user entries with a built-in name replace it.

hand_library.description: Custom finger / hand presets keyed by name. Same shape as pose_library; overlays the built-ins (peace_L/R, fist_L/R, point_L/R, open_palm_L/R, thumbs_up_L/R). Phases reference these via 'hand_L' / 'hand_R' fields.

lyrics.description: Karaoke-style lyric lines drawn as a 2D overlay on the viewport. Each entry: {at_sec | at_beat, text, duration_sec? | duration_beats?}. Default duration is 1 second when neither is set. Lines may overlap; the first matching line in array order wins per frame. Documents without a 'lyrics' field never touch the overlay.

path.description: WAV file path. Resolves relative to the .json document's directory; absolute paths accepted.

offset_sec.description: Constant offset added to the audio's clock before phase scheduling reads it. Use a negative value to make the dance start before the music.

sync_clock.description: When true, the runtime's wall-clock time provider is replaced by the audio player's playback position. The whole animation drifts with the music's actual rate.

audio.description: Optional audio attachment. When present, the runtime loads the WAV and starts playback at start; missing field → no audio module touched.

camera.description: Camera animation keyframes (sorted by time). Each entry: {at_sec | at_beat, position: [x,y,z], target: [x,y,z], fov?: degrees}. Runtime lerps between bracketing keyframes per frame and writes onto the viewport's Camera. Times before the first keyframe / after the last hold to that keyframe.

physics_chains.description: Per-chain tunings for the spring-physics host (hair / cloth ribbons). Applied at start().

scalar.description: Either a JSON number, a symbolic float ('pi', 'tau', 'e', 'pi/2', 'inf', etc.), or an inline expression string. Expressions go through a whitelisted-AST evaluator (see posecascade.scripting.expressions) with per-frame variables (elapsed, phase_t, phase_elapsed) and math fns (sin, cos, sqrt, clamp, lerp, ...).

value_curve.description: A scalar (constant), or a curve object that varies with phase_t in [0,1]. Snappier kinds (quad-in/out, cubic-in/out, back-out, pulse, step) exist for MMD-style accent hits — see docs/declarative_animation.md.

source.description: For kind='expression': inline expression evaluated each frame.

at.description: For kind='step': phase_t threshold (default 0.5). Value is 'from' below this, 'to' at or above it.

center.description: For kind='pulse': phase_t centre of the bell (default 0.5).

width.description: For kind='pulse': total width of the bell window (default 0.5).

character_root.description: Name of the scene node holding the character's root translation + yaw.

leg_chain_l.description: [upper, lower, foot] bone names for the L leg.

knee_limit_min.description: XYZ Euler radians clamping the knee's local rotation per IK iteration. (-2.4, 0, 0) keeps a knee on its hinge axis.

body_bones.description: Aliases mapping logical names (e.g. 'upper_leg_L') to actual bone names in the rig. Lets a single JSON document target rigs that use different naming conventions.

base_z.description: World Z of the staircase's front edge.

forward_sign.description: Sign of the walking direction along Z. -1 if the stairs go in -Z (default for the demo scene).

edge_smooth.description: Front-edge ramp width (m) for smoothing the height jump between adjacent stairs.

duration_beats.description: Phase length in beats. Requires the document-level 'bpm' to be > 0; mutually exclusive with 'duration_sec'.

blend_in_sec.description: Cross-fade-in window in seconds. The previous phase's blend_out_sec must also be > 0 for blending to happen; the actual overlap is min(prev.blend_out_sec, this.blend_in_sec).

blend_out_sec.description: Cross-fade-out window in seconds. The next phase's blend_in_sec must also be > 0 for blending to happen. Body / bones / morphs blend in unison; gait runs from the current phase only.

morphs.description: Morph-name → curve. Evaluated per frame; weight is written into the script's morphs API.

bones.description: Bone-name → per-axis curves. Drives any rig bone by composing Rz·Ry·Rx (extrinsic XYZ) in body frame, yaw-conjugated to world. Composes AFTER gait so an explicit per-bone curve overrides whatever the gait wrote on the same bone — useful for holding an arm overhead while a walking gait would otherwise swing it. Bone names go through the rig's body_bones alias map.

pose.description: Pose preset to apply UNDER the phase's bones (phase.bones overrides on a per-axis basis). Built-in names: v_arms_up, arms_to_chest, hip_pop_L, hip_pop_R, point_L, point_R, hands_clasp. The object form lets a phase ease the preset in/out via a per-frame weight curve.

hand_L.description: Left-hand finger preset name from the document's hand_library (built-ins: peace_L, fist_L, point_L, open_palm_L, thumbs_up_L). Composed after body pose, overridden per-axis by phase 'bones'.

hand_R.description: Right-hand finger preset name (built-ins: peace_R, fist_R, point_R, open_palm_R, thumbs_up_R).

bone_axes.description: Per-axis curves for one bone. All three are optional; missing axes are zero (identity rotation around that axis).

bone_axes_scalars.description: Per-axis scalars for one bone in a pose preset. Numbers only (presets are static silhouettes; the per-frame weight curve scales them).

rise_window.description: [t0, t1] within each per-stride normalised time where the body Y eases from current to next step height.

arm_hang_rad.description: World-Z rotation that flips the arms from rest T-pose down to a vertical hang. Mirrored per side. Defaults to -1.45 (~-83°), suitable for VRoid / Galaxia rigs whose upper arms rest along ±X. Set to 0 to keep arms in their rig rest pose.
World-Z rotation that flips the arms from rest T-pose down to a vertical hang. Mirrored per side. Defaults to -1.45 (~-83°). Set to 0 to keep arms in their rig rest pose.

lock_trailing_foot.description: Snapshot the trailing foot's world position at each step boundary and run analytical IK to keep it pinned. Default true; set false for running gaits where trailing-foot drift is desired.
